title: Entangling Atomic Quantum Memories Using High-Order Modulated Coherent States
summary: High-order coherent-state modulation and collective midpoint measurements enable multi-ebit entanglement distribution between cavity-coupled atomic memories. An SRM-inspired 16-QAM receiver achieves $1.75$ ebits per network mode use at $0.5$~dB end-to-end loss, exceeding single-qubit-per-mode benchmarks by $5.8$~dB and lying $3.8$~dB below the half-link capacity bound. The advantage persists for per-interface loss below $0.2$~dB and calibrated phase errors below $0.2π$.
